shortDescription: NetApp E-Series manage NVMe interface configuration

options.name: address
options.description: The IPv4 address to assign to the NVMe interface

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com:8443/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: channel
options.description: This option specifies the which NVMe controller channel to configure. The list of choices is not necessarily comprehensive. It depends on the number of ports that are available in the system. The numerical value represents the number of the channel (typically from left to right on the HIC), beginning with a value of 1.

options.name: config_method
options.description: The configuration method type to use for this interface. Only applicable when configuring RoCE dhcp is mutually exclusive with I(address), I(subnet_mask), and I(gateway).

options.name: controller
options.description: The controller that owns the port you want to configure. Controller names are presented alphabetically, with the first controller as A and the second as B.

options.name: gateway
options.description: The IPv4 gateway address to utilize for the interface. Only applicable when configuring RoCE Mutually exclusive with I(config_method=dhcp)

options.name: mtu
options.description: The maximum transmission units (MTU), in bytes. Only applicable when configuring RoCE This allows you to configure a larger value for the MTU, in order to enable jumbo frames (any value > 1500). Generally, it is necessary to have your host, switches, and other components not only support jumbo frames, but also have it configured properly. Therefore, unless you know what you're doing, it's best to leave this at the default.

options.name: speed
options.description: This is the ethernet port speed measured in Gb/s. Value must be a supported speed or auto for automatically negotiating the speed with the port. Only applicable when configuring RoCE The configured ethernet port speed should match the speed capability of the SFP on the selected port.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether or not the specified RoCE interface should be enabled. Only applicable when configuring RoCE

options.name: subnet_mask
options.description: The subnet mask to utilize for the interface. Only applicable when configuring RoCE Mutually exclusive with I(config_method=dhcp)
